title: Fabrication & Supply of 12.0m High G.I Trestle Tower for Replacement of South Button lighthouse & Construction of RCC Foundation and Erection of 12.0m High G.I Trestle Tower for Replacement of South Button lighthouse
summary: Percentage-rate e-tender to fabricate and supply a 12 m GI trestle tower, build its RCC foundation and erect it to replace South Button lighthouse, South Button Island, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)

sites.name: South Button Island (South Button lighthouse)
sites.work: Replacement with new 12 m GI trestle tower on RCC foundation

scope.item: Fabrication & supply of 12.0m high G.I trestle tower
Construction of RCC foundation and erection of 12.0m high G.I trestle tower

money.notes: Bid document free of cost (Hindi table says 'शुल्क' i.e. fee, without amount). EMD by deposit at call receipt/FDR of any nationalised bank (Hindi also allows bank guarantee) in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram, valid 06 months from technical bid opening; originals with technical documents by 16/12/2024 15:00. MSME/NSIC bidders registered for similar work eligible for EMD exemption.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Eligible experienced civil contractors with successful completion of similar work of construction of buildings/trestle tower in remote islands of Andaman & Nicobar with Government organizations, without adverse remarks
Detailed eligibility as per Section-III clause 3.1 of tender document (not included)
specs: 12.0 m high GI trestle tower on RCC foundation
notes: Section-I NIT only (pages 1-3 Hindi, 4-6 English); no BOQ. Download/submission period printed as '25/12/2024 (1500 Hrs) to 16/12/2024 (15-00 Hrs)', start date after end date (likely should be 25/11/2024); Hindi version gives start time 10:00. Technical opening subject to internet availability.
